messages:
emily-docs: opening a compact PR to tidy up private/on-prem docs: offline cert-bundle instructions, nftables + atomic iptables SNAT examples, a tiny PKCS#11 -> HSM-daemon migration pointer, and a Windows conn-checker snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4682 :wave:

danny-ops: thanks — couple asks: 1) add a port matrix table (tcp/udp + source ranges) so infra teams can copy it, 2) show iptables-save/restore pair for atomic apply, 3) add a note about provider-managed NAT gateways changing SNAT semantics, and 4) include an MTU troubleshooting one-liner for overlay networks.

priya-eng: adding the Windows example now, powershell + proxy is our support staple. will also add an example showing how to surface TLS chain errors for internal CAs.

priya-eng: ```
# PowerShell conn-checker snippet
$env:HTTPS_PROXY = 'http://proxy.corp:3128'
$env:RW_KEY = 'REDACTED'
node -e "const {Client} = require('@redwood/inference'); new Client({apiKey:process.env.RW_KEY}).text.create({model:'x-small',input:'ping'}).then(r=>console.log(r)).catch(e=>console.error(e.stack))"
```

jon-ml: for HSM rotation/migration: call out device perms and CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN as common failures. suggest systemd tmpfiles.d entry + chown/chmod example so runtime user retains access after reboots.

jon-ml: ```
# ensure runtime can access HSM device
chown root:redwood-runtime /dev/hsm0
chmod 660 /dev/hsm0
# /etc/tmpfiles.d/hsm.conf
w /dev/hsm0 - - - 0660 root redwood-runtime
```

docs-lint-bot: link-check FAILED: internal anchor "conn-checker#windows" -> 404. rule: internal-link-target.

priya-eng: fixed the anchor and tightened a stray code fence; pushing small edit to the same branch.

docs-lint-bot: re-run complete. link-check OK. markdown-style: OK. accessibility: warning (table missing header).

emily-docs: thanks all — merged after CI (commit b4f3e2d). leaving a TODO to add the full migration guide link in a follow-up PR so this installer doc stays small. :tada:
